items.quote: They shoot with anamorphic cinema lenses. You notice it the moment you see the first frame — nothing generic, nothing flat. Just beautiful.

items.quote: Real joy to work with. They made my life easy — photos and video that genuinely reflected the artists’ vibe, not just what was happening on stage.

items.quote: Exactly what we needed for the press kit. No back and forth.

items.quote: Clean delivery, well organized. Spatial documentation and hero shots covered everything: client handover, case study, pitch follow-up. Nothing needed chasing.

items.quote: The spatial sequences went straight into the award submission, no adjustments needed. Documentation that actually matches the quality of the build is not something you can count on.
